'I was expecting triplets so after the third popped out I went off for a cup of coffee, when I returned i was amazed to find another two had emerged'..The three girls and two boys are now being bottle fed every four hours as the struggling mum only has two teats to feed her hungry little flock with.

This June 8, 2018 photo shows writer Cain Burdeau using a scythe to cut the grass on a property in Contrada Petraro near Castelbuono, Sicily where he lives with his wife and two boys. He has chosen to cut the grass on his property with a scythe in part because he is following the example of his father, a long-time scythe user, but also because he prefers hand tools over mechanized ones. In Sicily it is important to cut grass as prevention against summertime fires. (Audrey Rodeman via AP)
